svg.title: Extreme set: propeller drones
svg.desc: Six panels. Three graph height against time for vertical moves. One shows an irregular 3D path from above and from the side. One shows a rounded 90 degree turn. One graphs distance against time for a stop and reverse along one line. A speed trace sits under each panel.
svg.text: Test limits in the generator: 264 m/s (949 km/h) and 16.4 g. They are not measured vehicle performance.
start and end of the part drawn
equal time steps: wide is fast
Each panel is a short part of a 300 s track, at its own scale. g is acceleration in units of 9.81 m/s².
Outside the part drawn, the target flies straight and level at constant speed, or hovers.
Straight up to top speed, then stop
Straight down to top speed, then stop
Up, down and up again, in place
Six high-g changes of direction in 3D, then
Two views, one scale. Dots every 5 s.
From above, north up. Dots every 0.5 s.
Stop, then back along the same line
Position over time. 0 m: the maneuver starts.
